_readme: Quick import template for Quiz sets. Keys that start with _ are ignored.
Each question: text (what is asked), image (optional), readAnswersAloud (true or false), hideAnswerText (optional, true or false), answers (2 or 3).
hideAnswerText: true shows only the picture on the answer cards (no text). The answer text is still read aloud.
Each answer: text (read aloud when picked), image (optional), correct (true for exactly ONE answer per question).
image: leave it as "" to upload the picture later in the editor, paste a link that starts with https:// from the internet, or paste SVG code (<svg ...>...</svg>).
SVG code: use single quotes inside the SVG, keep it on one line, under 30,000 characters, and include a viewBox. The same SVG used several times is saved as one file.
Question image: up to 2 MB, best at 600 x 300 px. Answer image: 84 x 84 px. SVG is best for sharp scaling (PNG, JPG, WebP also work).
Questions are added to the end of the current set. Press Save after importing.
